forms: what a verse says about how we are made
CRES.G4.CREATI.SELF_AWARENESS.UNIQUE_CRE.mastery: Says that God made each person, that each is unique and wonderfully made (Psalm 139:13-14), that people are made in God's image (Genesis 1:27), and that being special does not mean being better than others. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: what a verse says about anger or joy
what to do with a feeling
CRES.G4.CREATI.SELF_AWARENESS.FEELINGS.mastery: Names good thoughts (sharing, helping parents, being thankful), says why joy is good, and knows that Ephesians 4:26 says not to sin in anger or let the sun go down on it, and Philippians 4:4 says to rejoice in the Lord always. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

CRES.G4.CREATI.SELF_AWARENESS.CHOICES.mastery: Names everyday choices, says that every choice has a result for the child and others, and chooses what pleases God (honest, kind, obedient) over what friends or feelings push for. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

CRES.G4.CREATI.MY_FAMILY_FAMILY_MEMBERS..mastery: Tells the nuclear family (parents and children) from the extended family (grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins), and knows that Ephesians 6:1-3 asks children to obey and honour their parents, and why. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: what to do in a situation
which gift or invitation to refuse
CRES.G4.CREATI.MY_FAMILY_FAMILY_MEMBERS..mastery: Knows the body is private, that a child says NO, goes away and tells a trusted adult (a parent, a teacher, a church leader, the chief or the Childline Kenya helpline 116) if touched wrongly or asked to keep a secret, keeps telling until someone helps, and that it is never the child's fault. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: which sentence about God is true
CRES.G4.CREATI.ATTRIBUTES_OF_GOD.ATTRIBU.mastery: Says that God alone made everything (Genesis 1), that God is love and a loving Father (1 John 4:7-8), and that God is holy: there is none holy like the Lord (1 Samuel 2:2). Does not say that God shares making the world or loves only good children. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: which Testament a book is in
which books are the four Gospels
CRES.G4.THE_HO.THE_INSPIRED_WORD_OF_GOD..mastery: Places well-known books in the right Testament (Genesis, Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah in the Old; Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts, Revelation in the New) and knows the first book of each. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
what Zacchaeus did to show he had changed
CRES.G4.THE_HO.ZACCHAEUS_THE_TAX_COLLEC..mastery: Says that Zacchaeus was a rich chief tax collector, short, who climbed a tree to see Jesus; that Jesus called him down and went to his house though the crowd grumbled; that he gave half his possessions to the poor and promised to repay four times anything taken wrongly; and that repenting means being sorry and turning from wrong. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_HO.BALAAM_S_DONKEY.BALAAM.mastery: Says that Balak king of Moab sent for Balaam, that God told him to say only what God told him, that the donkey saw the angel of the Lord with a drawn sword three times before Balaam did, that the Lord opened the donkey's mouth and then Balaam's eyes, and that the lesson is to obey God. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
what the story shows about God
CRES.G4.THE_HO.SAMSON_KILLS_A_LION.SAMSO.mastery: Says that a young lion roared at Samson, that the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully on him, that he tore it apart with his bare hands, and that he did not tell his parents; and that the story shows God's power at work in a person. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the dreams
CRES.G4.THE_HO.JOSEPH_JOSEPH_INTERPRETS..mastery: Says that Pharaoh sent for Joseph from prison, that he dreamed of seven fat cows eaten by seven thin cows and of seven good ears of grain swallowed by seven thin ones, that Joseph said God would give the answer, and that the dreams meant seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: what the fear of the Lord means
a wise choice that depends on God
CRES.G4.THE_HO.JOSEPH_JOSEPH_INTERPRETS..mastery: Says that Joseph depended on God for the meaning of the dreams (Genesis 41:16), that Proverbs 1:7 says the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom (knowledge), and that fearing the Lord means honouring and obeying him, not being afraid of him. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the call
the new name and its meaning
CRES.G4.THE_HO.BIBLE_STRAND_QUESTION_S_..mastery: Says that God told Abram to leave his country for a land God would show him, with the promise of a great nation and a blessing for all peoples (12:1-3), that Abram obeyed, taking Sarai and Lot, and that God changed his name to Abraham, a father of many nations (17:5). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_LI.THE_ANNUNCIATION.ANNUNCIA.mastery: Says that the angel Gabriel was sent to Mary at Nazareth, that Mary was engaged to Joseph, that she was told to name her son Jesus, that the Holy Spirit would come upon her, and that for God nothing is impossible (Luke 1:37). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_LI.BIRTH_OF_JOHN_THE_BAPTIS..mastery: Says that Zechariah the priest and Elizabeth had no child and were old, that an angel appeared to Zechariah in the temple and told him to name the son John, that John was born, and that he would go before the Lord to prepare his way. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_LI.HEALING_OF_BLIND_BARTIMA..mastery: Says that Bartimaeus was a blind beggar by the road near Jericho, that he called out to Jesus, Son of David, and shouted louder when told to be quiet, that Jesus called him and asked what he wanted, that Jesus said his faith had healed him, and that he followed Jesus. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
a way of showing gratitude to God
CRES.G4.THE_LI.HEALING_BY_THE_END_OF_TH..mastery: Says that ten men with leprosy called to Jesus, that he told them to show themselves to the priests and they were cleansed on the way, that one, a Samaritan, came back praising God and thanked Jesus, and that Jesus asked where the other nine were; and gives ways of thanking God. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_LI.JESUS_RAISES_A_WIDOW_S_S..mastery: Says that Jesus met a funeral at Nain for the only son of a widow, that his heart went out to her, that he touched the coffin and said "Young man, get up", that the young man sat up and spoke, and that it shows Jesus' power over death and his compassion; and knows John 11:25. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

CRES.G4.THE_LI.FORGIVENESS.FORGIVE.mastery: Says that Matthew 5:39 teaches not to pay back evil with evil, gives reasons to forgive (peace, friendship, God forgives us), and knows that forgiving does not mean keeping quiet about being hurt: a child tells a trusted adult. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

CRES.G4.THE_LI.HELPING_THE_NEEDY.HELPING.mastery: Says that Matthew 5:42 teaches giving to the one who asks, gives reasons for helping (love, God cares for the needy), and names ways a child helps at school, home and church (sharing a pencil or lunch, carrying a load, a visit). Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the parable
CRES.G4.THE_LI.PARABLE_OF_THE_LOST_COIN..mastery: Says that a woman with ten silver coins lost one, lit a lamp, swept the house and searched carefully until she found it, and called her friends to rejoice; and that the lesson is that God loves the sinner, searches for him and rejoices when he repents. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the parable
what the seed and the tree stand for
how a child helps the kingdom grow
CRES.G4.THE_LI.PARABLE_OF_THE_MUSTARD_S..mastery: Says that a man planted a mustard seed in his garden, that it grew into a tree where birds perched, that God's kingdom starts small and grows, and that a child helps it grow by praying, living well and telling others. Evidence rule: at least four of the last five fresh questions right across at least two question forms, and no repeated pick of the same misconception.

forms: recall a fact of the story
CRES.G4.THE_LI.NICODEMUS_ENCOUNTER_WITH..mastery: Says that Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a member of the ruling council who came to Jesus at night, that Jesus told him one must be born again (of water and the Spirit), that Nicodemus did not first understand, and that John 3:16 says God so loved the world that he gave his Son so that whoever believes has eternal life.
